name: poe-ninja-time-machine-loadouts
description: Browser extension: poe.ninja time machine snapshots -> one PoB build with loadouts -> pobb.in

scripts.lint:firefox: npm run build && web-ext lint --self-hosted --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.package: npm run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir dist/packages --filename firefox-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chrome --artifacts-dir dist/packages --filename chrome-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest
